effect.name: Radial Light
effect.description: Turns a plain rectangle into a light: a soft radial pool of colour, or - with Invert on - a sheet of darkness with a hole cut in it. Two objects and this shader give you a whole lighting system without an extension.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Colour
parameter.description: Light colour with Invert off, darkness colour with it on.

parameter.name: Centre X
parameter.description: Centre of the light across the object.

parameter.name: Centre Y
parameter.description: Centre of the light down the object.

parameter.name: Radius
parameter.description: How far the light reaches, where 1 is the edge of the object.

parameter.name: Falloff
parameter.description: How quickly it fades. 1 is a straight ramp, higher values keep a bright core with a fast edge.

parameter.name: Banding
parameter.description: Quantises the falloff into this many bands, which keeps a soft light from looking out of place against pixel art. 0 is smooth.

parameter.name: Invert
parameter.description: Off draws the light. On draws darkness everywhere except the light, so the object becomes a shadow sheet with a hole in it.

parameter.name: Ignore Aspect
parameter.description: On lets the light stretch with the object instead of staying round.
